title: translation.config.json (pi-bestony-translate)
description: Project-level translation settings discovered by /translate and /review-translate. Unknown keys are reported and ignored.

$schema.description: Editor hint; ignored by the plugin.

sourceLang.description: BCP 47 tag of the source language (e.g. "en", "zh-CN") or "auto".

targets.description: Target languages offered for argument completion; /translate warns when a language is not listed.

tone.description: One or two sentences on register and voice, injected into the prompt as a project rule.

doNotTranslate.description: Words and phrases that stay in the source language.

preserve.description: Structural elements that must stay untouched (frontmatter, code, inline-code, urls, html-tags, image-paths, ...).

sourcePattern.description: Where /review-translate looks for the source of a translated file. Default "{dir}/{name}{ext}" after stripping .<lang> from the name.

suggestions.description: Let the agent append candidate terms to glossary.suggested.<ext>. Default true.
